# 275_R6WEB.1 — web-hardening (run ledger)

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/275_R6WEB.1__web-hardening.md` — handoff inserts (mode=extend); findings RH-30/31/23/32/33/34, re-verified at tip in the run.
**Branch:** `stevevitali/r6web-1-hardening` · **Base:** `main` @ `d24dbed8` · **Spend:** $0 (Stage A only; deploy-bound verify → `D-275_R6WEB.1-1`).

## Per-arm dispositions

- **RH-30 (CSP nonce, author-side):** `apps/web/src/server.ts` — the post-`next()` regex pass
  (`/<script(?=[\s>])/gi` over the whole body) is deleted; the nonce is minted pre-handler and rides
  `AsyncLocalStorage` (`apps/web/src/csp.ts` `cspHtmlMiddleware`/`runWithCspNonce`/`currentCspNonce` —
  the same pattern as `runWithPrincipal`). `renderDocument` + `renderSpaShell` stamp the tags they
  author; JSX emitters go through `NonceScript`/`CspNonceContext` (new `packages/ui/src/nonce-script.tsx`,
  converted: marketing, pages, demo-page, dossier-view, spa run-sheet, ui gate-card, ui page-editor ×4,
  ui run-sheet ×2). Response body is never rewritten; a tag the builders didn't emit fails closed.
- **RH-23 (mutation origin/fetch-site guard):** middleware in `server.ts` — non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS with
  an `Origin` must equal the request origin; headerless falls back to `Sec-Fetch-Site`, refusing
  `cross-site`; neither header ⇒ non-browser client, unaffected (the api `createOriginGuard` posture).
  Server-side `apiFetch` never traverses the host — its `origin: appBaseUrl` stamp is preserved verbatim.
- **RH-31 (magic-link interstitial):** the emailed href is now `GET /auth/magic-link?<same query>`
  (`magicLinkInterstitialUrl` in `apps/api/src/magic-link-email.ts` — refuses loudly on a non-verify
  path). The GET renders `MagicLinkPage` (no-consume); the confirm click POSTs the same URL and the
  web relays the query server-side to the api's GET verify via new `WebDeps.verifyMagicLink`
  (`main.ts` — cookie + resolved-IP stamp forwarded, response relayed verbatim incl. Set-Cookie).
  Journeys: `mailbox.ts` link matcher + `session.ts` confirm click (`data-magic-link-confirm`).
- **RH-32 (`ip_hash` keyed):** `analytics-routes.ts` now writes `HMAC-SHA256(pepper, "<UTC day>|<ip>")`
  (truncated 24 hex) of `forwardedClientIp` — the LB-appended penultimate hop, never the forgeable
  first hop — under a domain-separated pepper derived at composition from the loaded auth secret
  (`server.ts`; no new secret, no deploy change). Missing key ⇒ NULL, never an unsalted hash.
  Column kept; stored rows untouched. **Why HMAC not drop:** the funnel's unique-visitor dedupe is a
  built feature (P1.17) with prod history and active analysis (264's re-baseline); a keyed digest
  keeps the coarse signal while killing the rainbow-table liability — dropping loses the dimension
  for every future row.
- **RH-33 (`next` backslash admission):** `sameOriginPath` (new `packages/contracts/src/same-origin-path.ts`)
  compares the RESOLVED `url.origin` to the app origin — `/\evil.example`, `//host`, absolute foreign
  all refuse; consumed by `main.ts` `beginAuth` (the live wiring) and by web `POST /login` + `GET /login`.
- **RH-34 (deep-link `next`):** `loginHref(c)` carries `?next=<path+query>` through all ~140
  `c.redirect("/login")` gates (GET/HEAD only — a refused mutation can't be replayed); `GET /login`
  validates + lands signed-in users on it; `LoginPage` round-trips it as a hidden field;
  `POST /login` re-validates and forwards to `beginAuth` → the auth callbackURL. `PageData.login.next`
  + `dom-contract` `n("next")`/`a("data-magic-link-confirm")` declared.

## Judgement calls recorded

- **RH-32 pick:** keyed daily HMAC (kept the dedupe) over column-drop — see arm note.
- **RH-31 shape:** GET interstitial + form POST → server-side GET relay (better-auth verify is
  GET-only; a direct browser GET would re-burn the token). The page is a real document route under
  the same middlewares — nonce, guard, `no-store` all apply.
- **RH-34 scope:** GET/HEAD requests carry `next`; refused mutations redirect bare (non-replayable).
  `/signup`'s funnel intent (`/app?entry…`) is its own mechanism — untouched.
- **RH-30 nonce carriage:** AsyncLocalStorage (the `runWithPrincipal` precedent) rather than 90+
  call-site plumbing; un-nonced emit = fail-closed.
